name: Oregon
feeText: Dissolution of marriage, annulment or separation: $301 for the first appearance by petitioner, respondent or other party (ORS 21.155(1)), Oregon circuit court fee schedule effective 2026-01-01.

waiver.name: Fee Deferral and Waiver packet (Oregon Judicial Department Forms Center)

residency.text: If the marriage was solemnized in Oregon and the ground is irreconcilable differences, either party must be a resident or domiciliary when the suit is filed; otherwise at least one party must have been a resident or domiciliary for six months before filing (ORS 107.075).

waitingPeriod.text: No statutory waiting period found in ORS chapter 107; the marriage is terminated when the court signs the judgment of dissolution (ORS 107.115(2)).

simplified.text: Summary dissolution (ORS 107.485): no children of the marriage and no pregnancy, marriage of 10 years or less, no real property, unpaid debts since marriage of $15,000 or less, personal property under $30,000 net, petitioner waives spousal support and pendente lite orders, no other pending domestic relations suit.
